title: Final document
description: Approved status, two work items and active/paused projects. Exercises nested if → each → if → each → if content.
expected: Two work rows; complete and blocked tasks; review note; paused-project message; no watermark.

title: Draft with a watermark
description: A null email and a missing phone use fallbacks; uppercase URGENT still matches. More nested notes and an in-progress task.
expected: DRAFT NF-002 watermark, awaiting-approval and urgent text, safe email/phone fallbacks.

title: Null, missing and empty
description: Blank email, null address/message, missing nickname, empty work rows and an excluded project section. Header row remains.
expected: A header-only table, blank-email warning, address/message fallbacks, no project details.

title: Opaque draft watermark
description: The same template uses opaque JPEG images and an opaque text watermark. PDF/A-1b cannot accept transparency.
expected: PDF/A-1b with DRAFT NF-004 watermark at full opacity; no transparency flattening.

title: Editable Word output
description: Choose the DOCX provider explicitly. The nested logic and table rows use the same data language.
expected: An editable Word document with a resolved draft watermark and retained tables/images.

title: Empty list and literal text
description: An empty project list expands to no projects. A data string containing a placeholder is not evaluated a second time.
expected: No repeated project content; the literal text {customer.name} remains in the message.
